messages.en: What are you doing~?

messages.ko: 나는 퇴근하구 씻지도 못하고 털썩 누워있는중
messages.en: I just got off work and haven't even showered yet. I'm lying down after collapsing onto the bed.
Hehe.

messages.ko: 아니 나도 제니스 시그널 올라온거 보는데
messages.en: I was watching the Zenith Signal that got uploaded too.
The funny thing is...
Everyone put down their spoons and started talking,
but I was the only one who tied my hair back tightly
and started a full-on meal. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I just kept eating.
Lately, I'm really into nurungji,
completely hooked on it.
There happened to be some right there,
so I enthusiastically ate it. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
There's a snack called Nurungji Pop,
it's a type of snack.
It tastes like crispy fried nurungji coated with sugar.
It's so delicious
that I kept begging the members, 'Please just try one bite.'
'Please... ㅠㅠ'
I kept saying that,
but nobody wanted to try it,
so I was like, 'Hing...'
Then Joobin, Soomin, and Yubin
finally tried it.
'How is it!! What do you think!!!!'
I asked,
and they just said, 'It's okay.'
That was their answer,
and my heart was hurt.
No, it's not the hard kind of nurungji.
It's fried until it's super crispy,
The kind that's just really easy to crunch on,
almost like a fried snack.

messages.ko: 근데 요즘 내 올라오는 영상 사진 보니까
messages.en: But lately, when I look at the videos and photos of me being uploaded,
my cheeks look so huge.
I was really surprised by today's Signal too.
So today as well,
I still tried to eat like I was dieting,
but...
after the fansign,
the leftover salt bread looked way too delicious,
so I just ate it.
Failed today >< Starting again tomorrow~
I guess you should change your phone wallpaper back to 'Lose Weight.'
The scary thing is... it's still that wallpaper.
But now I don't even pay attention to it anymore.
It's just become my wallpaper.
Unnie, do you have your own dieting secret..?
I wish I had something like that too. ㅎ
Seriously though,
"It's okay if you gain weight, you're cute,"
don't keep saying things like that.
My brain actually starts believing it.
And...
right now,
I don't think **Y/n** realizes this,
but the reason I seem cute and pretty
is because you're looking at me through love-colored glasses.
If a third person saw me,
they'd probably think, 'Who's that woman with those huge cheeks?'
Like that.
That's how it'd be.
Who cares what other people think? You're pretty in my eyes.
Oh.
That's romantic.
I've been reading romantic books lately too.
"Even If These Tears Disappear from the World Tonight."
This one.
Don't ask me what it's about...
I've only read about 20 pages so far. ㅎ
Is it for the same purpose as Nakyoung's *101 Dalmatians*???

messages.ko: 아니 요즘 잠 못잔다니까 언니가 ㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: No, I told unnie I've been having trouble sleeping lately. ㅋㅋㅋ
She insisted I absolutely had to read it.
She highly recommended it.
When she mentioned *101 Dalmatians*,
I actually thought...
she meant I should count 101 Dalmatians to fall asleep.

messages.ko: 로블록스, 배그하던 정하연 어디가고 요즘 책읽는 그 여자는 누구야?
messages.en: Where did Jeong Hayeon who used to play Roblox and PUBG go? Who's this girl reading books these days?
I feel sorry for my friends in those games,
but I've gotten a little tired of them lately.
Then come play LoL.
That's the place where everyone flames you.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
It's way too harsh for me.
Just pretend you're older.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 학생.들~ 내가 섯툴러서 .미안합니다~ 여기는.나무가 이쁘.게 자라있내요 .들어가면 안되는 곳인가요~~?^^
messages.en: Stu.dents~ I'm sor.ry I'm not very good at this~ The trees are grow.ing so nicely here. Are we not allowed to go in~~?^^
I'm unnecessarily good at acting like that.

messages.ko: 지금 못씻고 털썩 쓰러진 상태에서 저거 하나하나 쓴거야?
messages.en: Did you really type all of that one character at a time while lying there without showering?
Sometimes it's okay even if you don't shower.
Aohㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
No matter what happens, I always shower before I sleep.
Even if I accidentally fall asleep,
my body reacts on its own,
so I suddenly wake up in the middle of the night.
Then I shower and go back to sleep.
These days, showering makes me happy.
It's practically the national rule to sing while showering.
But because the members are around,
I couldn't really sing.
Now that I'm in the U.S., I think I'll sing as much as I want. ㅎ
When I sing at my parents' house,
my mom says from outside,
"Be quiet and hurry up!"
That's what she says. ㅋㅋ
I imagine the showerhead is rain,
and since it's raining,
I sing songs like that,
or sing emotional ballads pretending I'm crying.
That's what I do.
Sometimes I even have to act a little.
Pretend to cry.
I'm getting secondhand embarrassment...
Tsk, you'd do it too.
The bathroom mirror just looks so perfect for it.
You have to deliver at least one dramatic line while looking at yourself.
"How could you do this to me..? Heol... *sob* ㅜㅜ"
Don't you get hit with reality afterward?
I don't know anything about that.
While staring into the mirror. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
"Who do you think you are..?"
"Who are you to tell me what to do?"
Speaking of bowing...
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
When I was little,
when my dad went to work, I missed him so much,
so I recorded a video message for him.
My older brother was filming me,
and he kept telling me what to do.
"Say you love him."
"Make a heart too."
"Say you miss him."
Like that.
I was doing everything he told me to do,
then my brother said,
"Try bowing."
That's what he said.
So I politely
gave a bow.
But what he had actually said was, "Do it again."
I had misheard him,
so I randomly bowed all by myself.
Even now, my mom and my brother
still tease me about that.
Sometimes my family gathers together,
puts on my childhood videos and photos on the TV,
and we just sit there talking about them.
All of my embarrassing childhood moments are in there.
There's a video of me
dancing while passionately singing a Girls' Day song live.
I think it was 'Darling.'
There's also Suzy sunbaenim and Baekhyun sunbaenim's
'Dream.'
I sang it as a duet with my brother,
and my mom even filmed a music video for us.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Your brother probably sings well too. ㅋㅋㅋ
No. ㅋㅋ
But he thinks he's a good singer.
Not long ago,
he asked me to practice 'All For You'
and wanted us to sing it together.
I think he'd ruin my song.

messages.ko: 오빠가 엄청 이뻐하시나보다 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 보통 동생한테 그런얘기 잘안하던데
messages.en: Your brother must really adore you. Usually older brothers don't do things like that for their younger sisters. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
My family is basically my fan club.
They all fangirl over me.
Your mom's behind you.
Hello..!!
Oh no.
The book I was reading...
I don't remember where I stopped.
I forgot to use a bookmark.
I have no idea where I left off.
Wait, it actually wasn't page 20.
Ha...
What the...
I had actually read up to page 32.
Looks like I read more than I thought. ㅋㅋ
How is it?
A girl reading a book for you.
I'll read it like a radio show.
How is it?
It really makes you sleepy, right?
Haha, maybe I should make this into content.
Experience your past life.
Sweet dreams guaranteed.
How was that? A 30-second past life experience.
Apparently I was Hayeon's fan even in my past life?
Then I guess you and I are destined to meet.
Hohoho.
I was so happy I turned into Ddotty. (Hoit-cha!)

messages.ko: 아니 이거 도티님이 보고 리액션한거 봤는데
messages.en: I actually saw Ddotty reacting to that.
Then Ddotty said,
"The kids who used to watch my videos..."
"...grew up so well~"
I saw a clip where he said something like that.
It was really touching.
I remember his Minecraft jump maps too...
Just recently,
it suddenly came to mind,
so I watched Ddotty's Minecraft 'Train to Busan.'
I watched it.
When I was little, I watched it while being scared.
I was also really sad.
At the end, when they escaped in the helicopter...
'Nooo... ㅠㅠㅠ'
I remember watching it while sobbing.
That's such a nostalgic memory.
Next Monday's low is supposed to be 5°C.
What?!
It's really gotten cold lately.
I need to buy winter clothes.
Seriously.
When I go to school,
maybe because it's the morning, it feels even colder.
Wearing my school uniform with a long padded coat,
while cursing my school's wide-open hallways,
walking through them...
Those memories came back to me.
Be careful not to catch a cold.
It's heater season now.
After I clean up...
Ha... I really need to go shower.
I think I'm about to fall asleep.
Good night~
See you in our past-life experience~
Haranghae~ 🥰🥰
